title: DEBT90: a send notice joins the bar after the worklist lands
note: A send notice can join the send bar after it first draws. The pending bar in `Pricing.tsx` draws no notice. `SendCard` and its first `GET /pipeline/sends` start only when the worklist lands. A notice stands for a day after a checked send (`STANDS_MS`), and for any open, short or unreadable receipt.
